senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. איש, , const. אֵשֶׁת, woman, wife.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 25b:3">Ab. Zar. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ כלי זיינה עליה</he> woman carries her weapon with her, is protected against murder by gentiles (who would rather assault her innocence).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 25b:4">Ib.</cite> <he>א׳ חשובה</he> a woman of high rank (influential).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 25b:2">Ib.</cite> <he>אִשְתּוֹ משמרתו</he> his wife’s presence guards him from wrong-doing; a. fr.—Pl. (<he>נָשׁוֹת</he>) <he>נָשִׁים</he> q. v.
